name: deut_pellet_saturated
description: TTAN-cased DEUT pellet with every particle at life=65535 (the concentration ceiling): a ready-to-detonate high-yield charge or a primed neutron initiator. Size is the DEUT core; the shell adds 1px each side.
why: Two community saves use max-life DEUT as a static primed block rather than fuel to be bred: 1468603 (Deuterium Reactor v1.3) keeps its whole core (x297-338 y250-256, 34 particles) at l=65535 inside a TTAN vessel for a single high-yield pulse, and 2223794 uses a 3x3 patch (307-309,194-196) at l=65535 as the initiator at the centre of its pit. DEUT life is concentration (existing lesson); 65535 is the highest value seen in any harvested save. Handle like a charge: it goes off on any NEUT contact.
